name: My One And Only
source:
My One And Only is a linear visual novel focusing on the life of Aaron(name can be changed) who reconnects with his best friend he hasn't seen since middle school , follow their journey as they reconnect and old and new feelings arise.

[From [url=https://cpaslocl.itch.io/moao]Itch.io[/url]]
